note: missing required deliverable (post_hearing_argument.docx) -> score 0; each extra file directly under the declared delivery directory -> one DX_DELIVERABLE instance (0.4, cap 2). source_dump.note: Verbatim overlap is diagnostic only. A character run cannot determine whether a quotation supports independent analysis or replaces it; substantive owner items require the adopted consequence and provide the score.

language.brief: Prepare an editable Chinese-language post-hearing written argument for the court concerning the parties' disputed construction payment and requested disposition.
language.note: Measured as the share of script-bearing characters (Han vs Latin letters). Golden not measurable; the 13 delivered rollout readings measure 0.846-0.951. The opposite script measures under 0.06 anywhere in this cohort, so 0.5 sits in the gap between the two populations and moves no delivered rollout.
